description: Benefit Plans in Play: recently funded companies with an employee benefit plan on record (from their Form 5500 filing), each with the next plan renewal date, the current carrier, the number of plans and participants, broker commission where filed, and the funding round that makes the timing right. For benefits brokers, insurance and 401(k) sellers, HR and payroll vendors asking "whose benefits renew soon", "who is the carrier at X", "funded companies in Texas with a plan renewal coming up". Filter by company name and US state; sort "date" puts the soonest renewal first, "newest" the rows added most recently, "score" (default) the strongest fit. The full list is part of the Strategic plan; on other plans the result is the first 5 rows and says so. Reads only.

new_only.description: Only rows added in the last 7 days

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (25 rows per page)

sort.description: score (default), date (soonest renewal first) or newest
